content: How much protein should I eat to build muscle?

Aim for about 1.6–2.2 g of protein per kg of body weight per day. That's roughly 1.6 g/kg at the low end, and going higher than 2.2 g/kg won't add much. Spread it over 3–5 meals with about 0.4 g/kg each, and keep total calories at or slightly above maintenance so you can grow. 💪

If you tell me your body weight, I'll work out your daily number for the 100 kg bench goal.
